entities.summary: Patrick Moraz (b. 1948-06-24, Morges) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Morges and Switzerland. Known in the fields of switzerland, composers & musicians, europe.
